description:
Upstream's `app.thinking.cycle` (Shift+Tab) cycles through thinking levels: off → low → medium → high → off. The current level is shown in the footer status bar.

Our Interactive has no thinking level UI at all — the Session.State has a `thinking_level` field but there's no keyboard shortcut or UI to change it at runtime.

Implement: handle Shift+Tab to cycle `thinking_level` on the session, show a brief notification of the new level, and reflect it in the footer.

Ref: `interactive-mode.ts` L3313-3328, `cycleThinkingLevel()`.
title: Interactive: thinking level cycling (Shift+Tab)
